item.title: AppLovin changes its ROAS bidding for puzzle games
item.dc:creator: Staff
item.description:
AppLovin now bids on D7 ROAS for puzzle and sort games & casual titles. Studios report a 12% lower CPI after the switch.

The post AppLovin changes its ROAS bidding appeared first on Gamigion.
